title: LUMIR: Decoupled Multimodal Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Data for Next-POI Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As multimodal tourism-related information collected from heterogeneous data sources has become increasingly available, learning effective representations has attracted attention for improving recommendation performance. Existing approaches often tightly couple multimodal fusion with the architecture and optimization objective of a specific downstream model, which limits the generality and reusability of the learned representations. To address these limitations, we propose LUMIR, a decoupled multimodal representation learning framework based on contrastive learning. Multimodal information collected from heterogeneous data sources is first semantically unified into a shared textual representation space using large language models (LLMs). An interaction-aware fusion mechanism is then designed to model cross-modal interactions, while sequential signals are incorporated as a structural constraint to guide representation learning. translated_title: LUMIR：面向下一兴趣点推荐的异构数据解耦多模态表示学习
translated_abstract: 随着从异构数据源收集的多模态旅游相关信息日益丰富，学习有效的表示以提升推荐性能受到了广泛关注。现有方法通常将多模态融合与特定下游模型的架构和优化目标紧密耦合，这限制了所学表示的通用性和可重用性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了LUMIR，一个基于对比学习的解耦多模态表示学习框架。首先利用大语言模型将从异构数据源收集的多模态信息在语义上统一到共享的文本表示空间中，随后设计交互感知的融合机制来建模跨模态交互，同时将序列信号作为结构约束纳入以指导表示学习。为评估（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出解耦多模态表示学习框架LUMIR，利用大语言模型将异构多模态数据统一到共享文本空间，并通过对比学习结合交互感知融合与序列信号约束进行训练，使学习到的表示与下游推荐模型解耦，提升下一兴趣点推荐中多模态表示的通用性和可重用性。
en_tdlr: LUMIR is a decoupled multimodal representation learning framework that uses LLMs to unify heterogeneous multimodal data into a shared textual space and employs contrastive learning with interaction-aware fusion and sequential constraints, enhancing the generality and reusability of representations for next-POI recommendation.
